children: Flop Labs has updated the tokenomics for FLOP, including a projected total supply of 18.1 billion tokens in the 10th year, slightly higher than before, and a long-term annual inflation rate of 0.5%, slightly lower than before. According to Foresight News, 48.6% of the supply will go to miners, 24.3% will be allocated to airdrops, 10.8% will be assigned to the team and foundation, 6.5% will be split between validators and Brokers/Agent, and 3.2% will be used for staking rewards.

title: Flop Labs Updates FLOP Tokenomics, Sets 10-Year Supply at 18.1 Billion
